name: Bakunyuu Yuukaku ~Iyasare Tayuu Haramase no Yakaku~
original_name: 爆乳遊廓 ～癒され太夫孕ませの夜鶴～
source:
It was the 5th spring in a time of beautiful harmony,  a time when kimonos and sandals were still widely worn.

In Fukamachi, a red-light district located in Kosaka, 2 certain incidents are threatening people's lives. One was an extremely vicious assault, the other is persistent acts of stalking targeted at prostitutes, their owners and whoever went into the red-light district.

These insidious crimes have become an object of fear and has gradually driven people away from the red-light district.

Through his best friend "Kuroji", the protagonist is offered a job as a bodyguard for a Tayu ranked courtesan named "Yozuru". Although he has never worked as a bodyguard before, he immediately agrees, thinking that he can repay his debt to the temple for its hospitality.

However, when night comes along, the courtesan approaches the protagonist who is standing guard. What was supposed to be a simple distraction from her anxiety turns into something more! Just how far will it go...?

Investigating cases during the day, and having a titty-fucking session with a busty courtesan at night before going to bed, this is a slightly raunchy fantasy! A Japanese-style otherworldly fantasy!
translation:
这是第五个春天，一个美丽和谐的时期，和服和凉鞋仍然被广泛穿着。

在位于小坂的红灯区深町，发生了两起威胁人们生命的事件。一种是极其恶毒的袭击，另一种是针对妓女、她们的主人以及任何进入红灯区的人的持续跟踪行为。

这些阴险的犯罪行为已经成为人们恐惧的对象，并逐渐驱赶人们远离红灯区。

通过他最好的朋友“Kuroji”，主角得到了一份为名为“Yozuru”的太由等级名妓做保镖的工作。虽然他从来没有当过保镖，但他立刻就答应了，认为这样可以报答寺庙的盛情款待。

然而，当夜幕降临时，妓女却走近了守卫的主角。原本应该是简单地分散她的焦虑的事情变成了更多的事情！到底会走多远……？

白天查案，晚上睡觉前和巨乳名妓爆乳，这简直是有点不修边幅的幻想啊！日式异界奇幻！
